tail.source: sum of the per-shard kld_tail histograms

binning.underflow: counts[0]: v < bin_edges[0], including every exact zero

tail.method: counts add across shards, percentiles do not: each quantile is reported as the [lower, upper] bin interval that provably contains it, plus a log-uniform point estimate inside that interval. max_kld_exact and the exceedance counts are exact, not interpolated.

consistency.note: headline numbers are recomputed from per-context rows and cross-checked against each shard report's own summary

not_aggregable.token_percentiles_exact: an exact cumulative median/p95/p99/p999 would need the token-level KLD vector, which no shard report carries. `tail.quantiles` bounds each one by the histogram bin it falls in, which is exact to the bin width; each shard's own exact percentiles are in its report
not_aggregable.jsd_percentiles: shard reports carry only the position-weighted mean JSD, so its distribution cannot be recovered here
